about: The only product claims Cite Ledger's README, product page, listings and marketing may make. P1-P6 and L1-L3 are the accepted register (accepted 2026-10-19). Proposed claims may not appear on any public surface until accepted. scripts/check-claims.mjs enforces this and checks that each claim's tests exist; npm test must pass in the same run.

claims.text: Flags references whose DOI does not resolve in Crossref.
tests: P1: flags a reference whose DOI does not resolve in Crossref (unregistered-DOI fixture)

claims.text: Flags retractions, corrections and expressions of concern recorded in Crossref, including Retraction Watch data.
claims.evidence: Known retracted DOI fixture; Crossref blog, 2025-01-29: https://www.crossref.org/blog/retraction-watch-retractions-now-in-the-crossref-api/
tests: P2: flags a retraction and a correction recorded by Retraction Watch (known retracted DOI fixture)
P2: flags an expression of concern recorded in Crossref

claims.text: Shows where an entry's title, year or first author differs from the Crossref record.
tests: P3: shows where the title, year and first author differ from the Crossref record (mismatch fixture)

claims.text: Marks references with no matching Crossref record as unverified.
claims.proText: Marks references with no matching Crossref record as unverified and shows the closest match.
tests: P4: marks a reference with no matching Crossref record as unverified (free, no closest match)
P4 Pro: shows the closest match for an unverified reference
P4: a reference without a DOI that search confirms is not marked unverified

claims.text: Runs on your machine and sends only the reference details it looks up to Crossref.
claims.evidence: Network test: only api.crossref.org is called during a check
tests: P5: checking every fixture file calls only api.crossref.org and sends no prose
P5: a free CLI run calls only api.crossref.org and never contacts the licence server

claims.text: Single-file checks are free; Pro is a one-time licence.
claims.evidence: Live Polar product page at the price Darren set. The price is quoted from that page, never typed from memory.
tests: single-file checks, including retraction flags, are free and exit 0

claims.text: Does not check DOIs registered outside Crossref, for example DataCite.
Crossref's retraction data can miss some retractions.
'Unverified' means no matching record was found, not that the reference is fabricated.
Reads .bib files, LaTeX thebibliography lists and Markdown reference sections.
tests: reads entries, fields, DOIs and lines from the fixture
reads thebibliography items, \doi and ignores comments
reads the References section, inline DOIs in prose, and skips code fences

claims.text: Pro adds workspace-wide scans, CLI/CI exit codes, Markdown, CSV and JSON reports, and closest-match suggestions.
tests: unlocks workspace scan, exit codes, export and closest match
Markdown, CSV and JSON reports carry evidence links and limits L1-L3

claims.text: Makes no AI model calls: every check is a lookup in Crossref's records.
claims.evidence: Network test: only api.crossref.org is called during a check
tests: P5: checking every fixture file calls only api.crossref.org and sends no prose

claims.text: A Pro licence check sends your licence key, and no reference data, to Polar, the payment provider.
tests: licence validation sends only the key and public identifiers, with no secret
